description_en: Modifies the status of protected objects or protected object groups for the API security protection module
description_zh: 修改API安全防护模块生效防护对象或防护对象组状态
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi modify-apisec-module-status --instance-id waf_elasticity-cn-0xldbqtm00 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyApisecModuleStatus

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to obtain the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html获取当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the protected object.

You must specify at least one of Resources and ResourceGroups
parameters.help_zh:
防护对象名称。

Resources 和 ResourceGroups 至少须指定一个
parameters.name: resources

parameters.help_en:
The compliance review status. Valid values: 
1: Enabled.
0: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
合规审查状态。取值： 
1：表示开启。
0：表示关闭
parameters.name: report_status

parameters.help_en:
The tracing audit status. Valid values: 
1: Enabled.
0: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
溯源审计状态。取值： 
1：表示开启。
0：表示关闭
parameters.name: trace_status

parameters.help_en:
The name of the protected object group to which the protected object is added.

You must specify at least one of Resources and ResourceGroups
parameters.help_zh:
防护对象加入的防护对象组的名称。

Resources 和 ResourceGroups 至少须指定一个
parameters.name: resource_groups

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id
